verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph API gives programmatic access to OneDrive items (search across a whole drive, delta query for tracking many changed items, generic copy/move mentioned) which could support bulk automation, but there is no explicit documentation of a batch/bulk operation endpoint (e.g., deleting, moving, or copying many items in a single call) or any hands-on evidence of doing bulk operations at scale. Missing for 10: explicit batch API docs for driveItems, documented bulk delete/move/copy across many items in one request, and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk automation working reliably.
